quizzes.backend_description: This image shows a circle with degree markings at 0°, 90°, 180°, and 270°. Small dashes are spaced 15° apart around the circle. One ray points to the right at 0°, and another ray extends to the 60° mark. The angle between the rays is shaded in light green with a dark green arc on the edge. The angle measures 60 degrees.
solution: The shaded region inside the circle shows the angle to measure.
The angle ends at the fourth dash. Since the dashes are 15° apart, count by 15° 4 times.
The measure of the angle is 60°.
